name: Delete Workflow Runs
description: GitHub Action to delete workflow runs in a repository.

baseUrl.description: GitHub API base URL (for GitHub Enterprise)

retain_days.description: Number of days to retain workflow runs

keep_minimum_runs.description: Minimum number of runs to keep per workflow (or per day if use_daily_retention is true)

use_daily_retention.description: If true, keep_minimum_runs will be applied per day instead of overall

delete_workflow_pattern.description: Workflow name or filename pattern (omit for all)

delete_workflow_by_state_pattern.description: Workflow states to target (comma-separated or ALL)

delete_run_by_conclusion_pattern.description: Run conclusions to target (comma-separated or ALL)

check_branch_existence.description: Skip runs from existing branches (excludes main)

check_pullrequest_exist.description: Skip runs linked to pull requests
